rules.title: PrismHAStandbyReplayLagHigh
rules.expr: clamp_max((max(pg_stat_replication_replay_lag{job="qbit-postgres-primary",network="__NETWORK__",application_name="prism_standby_1"} > bool 5) or vector(0)) + (max(pg_stat_replication_replay_lag{job="qbit-postgres-primary",network="__NETWORK__",application_name="prism_standby_1"} < bool 0) or vector(0)) + (1 - ((count(pg_stat_replication_replay_lag{job="qbit-postgres-primary",network="__NETWORK__",application_name="prism_standby_1"}) > bool 0) or vector(0))) + (1 - (max(pg_up{job="qbit-postgres-primary",network="__NETWORK__"}) or vector(0))), 1)
rules.description: D3: primary-side replay lag exceeds 5 seconds, is unknown, or the primary exporter/database cannot be read. Deployment-provided: requires primary postgres_exporter query metrics; verify presence in #281/#291. This is not the public read replica.

rules.title: PrismHAStandbyDisconnected
rules.expr: clamp_max((1 - ((max(pg_stat_replication_count{job="qbit-postgres-primary",network="__NETWORK__",application_name="prism_standby_1"}) > bool 0) or vector(0))) + (1 - (max(pg_up{job="qbit-postgres-primary",network="__NETWORK__"}) or vector(0))), 1)
rules.description: D3: the primary has zero rows for application_name prism_standby_1, or the exporter/database is missing or failed. Deployment-provided: requires primary postgres_exporter query metrics; verify presence in #281/#291. This is not the public read replica.
